01 / Applied AI · Internship

Scribsy

I built the audio transcription, structured SOAP generation, and note-management workflow for a clinical documentation application.

Software Engineering Intern · N-of-1 AI
June — August 2025

Next.js interface · FastAPI backend

  1. Audio
  2. Transcript
  3. SOAP draft
  4. Review

The problem

Turn a recorded conversation into an organized draft that a practitioner can inspect and edit.

My contribution

Connected audio processing, structured note generation, and a Next.js review interface through FastAPI endpoints.

Key engineering decision

Make the generated note a reviewable draft.

Keep the transcript and structured SOAP sections available in the review workflow, so the practitioner can check and revise the output before exporting it.

Architecture & implementation +
Structure
Whisper transcription feeds a separate summarization service. The response separates subjective, objective, assessment, and plan fields instead of returning an unstructured paragraph.
API behavior
The backend separates upload endpoints, transcription, summarization, note schemas, and CRUD operations. Invalid audio and processing failures return explicit errors.
Public demonstration
The sample visit uses fictional content. Editing and PDF export can be explored without an account or a live AI request.

DeliveredAn audio-to-note review workflow with editable sections and note management.

Next.js · FastAPI · Whisper · Structured SOAP output

03 / Client website · Professional project

Holcomb Tree Service

I rebuilt Holcomb Tree Service’s website to make its tree-care services easier to explore and help prospective customers request a consultation.

Software Engineer · Arrows Up
Client website rebuild

Holcomb Tree Service · Tree-care website rebuild

  1. Explore services
  2. Find the right care
  3. Request consultation

The problem

Help visitors find relevant tree-care services and move easily from learning about the company to requesting a consultation.

My contribution

Built responsive page layouts, organized the service navigation, and implemented clear consultation entry points as part of the Arrows Up team.

Key design decision

Keep the path from service to consultation clear.

Connect the company’s service information with prominent estimate and consultation actions, so visitors have a clear next step as they explore the site.

Scope & implementation +
Visitor journey
Organized the service information and consultation entry points around the needs of prospective tree-care customers.
Implementation
Rebuilt responsive interfaces and routing with SvelteKit. The linked Cloudflare staging site demonstrates the client-facing result.
Attribution
Client project completed as part of the Arrows Up team. This case study describes the Holcomb website rather than my broader work across client platforms.

DeliveredA responsive tree-care website with clear service navigation and prominent consultation requests.

SvelteKit · TypeScript · Responsive web · Cloudflare

Dozerformer Research

I ran Dozerformer ablation experiments comparing full encoder–decoder, encoder-only, and decoder-only architectures for time-series forecasting, and coauthored the ITNG 2026 paper.

The experiments examine what each architectural component contributes by comparing the full model with simpler variants.

Python · PyTorch · Dozerformer · Ablation studies
